integrity: Proof is analytic and supported by exact rational regression checks; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All a_i,b_i>0 and finite m; completed classical RK4 on row CTMC generators only. Positivity of internal stages or general nonlinear flows is not claimed. Unindexed stronger prior results remain possible.
title: An exact one-edge positivity horizon for fourth-order Runge–Kutta on bidirected stars
